name: HTML
description: HyperText Markup Language, document structure, accessibility, and modern SEO semantic standards.

name: CSS
description: Cascading Style Sheets, modern layouts (Flexbox/Grid), specificity, variables, animations, and typography.

name: JavaScript
description: Core JS engine, event loop, closures, scopes, asynchronous operations, prototypes, and array manipulation.

name: TypeScript
description: Static typing, interfaces, type aliases, generics, utility types, compile options, and type safety patterns.

name: React
description: Reconciliation, components, hooks, custom hooks, fiber, state management, context, and performance tuning.

name: Browser & Rendering
description: Critical rendering path, DOM/CSSOM, reflows, repaints, defer/async, web workers, and rendering APIs.

name: Performance
description: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), lazy loading, caching, compression, virtualization, and code splitting.

name: Accessibility
description: Semantic tags, aria attributes, focus management, keyboard control, and WCAG AA contrast compliance.

name: Security
description: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), CSRF, CORS, Content Security Policy (CSP), cookies, and secure authorization.

name: System Design
description: Building widgets (combobox, calendar, table), data architectures, state sync, local-first apps, and scale.

name: Coding Questions
description: Solving real JS code challenges: custom promises, deep cloning, throttling, event emitters, and search.

name: Behavioral Questions
description: Standard behavioral patterns: STAR framework, conflict resolution, project leadership, and engineering trade-offs.
